input_contract.lead_ordering: Canonical Cabrera Sequence (I, II, III, aVR, aVL, aVF, V1, V2, V3, V4, V5, V6)
input_contract.input_formatting: src.models.ecg_fm_primary.FrozenECGFM.format_input (deterministic shape enforcement and tensor broadcasting, NOT a trainable neural network)

output_contract.derivation_source: Output of the 12th Transformer encoder block (features_only=True)
output_contract.pooling_method: Temporal mean-pooling across temporal dimension dim=1
output_contract.projection_head: NONE (Native pooled representation is used directly as Z_ECG without projection or bottleneck)

pretraining_methodology.methodological_implication: ECG-FM was exposed to random lead masking during self-supervised pretraining. Therefore, high representation stability across lead levels is expected; the present research evaluates whether downstream evidence-grounded clinical reasoning remains reliable as physical lead observability decreases.
